minutes.headline: Zoning Board granted a special permit for a garage at 22 Fairview Road with a 4.2-foot side setback.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals held a single public hearing on a petition from the Hillbilly Trust for a 32 by 39 foot attached garage at 22 Fairview Road, which intensifies a side-lot-line nonconformity. The applicant described wetlands constraints and the roof height; no public comment was received. The board voted to grant the special permit, read the post-decision instructions, and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted to grant a special permit for a 32 by 39 foot attached garage at 22 Fairview Road, including the dimensional variation.
The garage intensifies an existing side-lot-line nonconformity; the approved side setback is 4.2 feet.
The applicant discussed wetlands constraints and roof height; a suggested condition on building height was discussed and not adopted, the applicant citing building inspector review.
No public comment was recorded at the hearing.
The board stated that a member writes the decision, it is signed at the next meeting and then filed with the town clerk; the next meeting was stated as the 26th.

why_it_matters: This is a decision on one lot's side setback, and it touches neighbors and abutters of 22 Fairview Road; it does not affect a tax bill, a school or a town budget line.
The written decision is not final until it is signed and filed with the town clerk, which is the point from which the appeal period would be counted.
